name: The Travel Book Shop (Film Facade)
description: The shopfront dressed up as William Thacker's travel bookshop in 'Notting Hill' (1999). Back then it was Nicholls Antique Arcade; today it is a souvenir shop still signed 'The Travel Book Shop'.
highlight: The film's famous 'Travel Book Shop' at 142 Portobello Road
address: 142 Portobello Road, London W11, United Kingdom
